_about: Tools required by the UEM methodology. Sources, versions and commands are fixed here on purpose: the executor installs exactly these, never a source it found by searching. Verified 2026-11-06. Each install needs the user's explicit approval (maestro tools <project> --approve <id>).

requirements.name: Superpowers (skills: brainstorming, writing-plans, test-driven-development, verification-before-completion, requesting-code-review, using-git-worktrees)
Elephant-Goldfish Model (skills: egm-brainstorm, egm-review, egm-draft; fresh-context adversarial review)
Harness Engineering: harness-creator skill (AGENTS.md, feature_list.json, init.sh, progress and handoff files)
Everything Claude Code, minimal profile for Antigravity (rules, workflows, skills, agents in .agents/)
install: cd "{project}" && npx ecc-universal@2.2.3 install --profile minimal --target antigravity
requirements.note: Pinned exact version. Writes into <project>/.agents/; review the diff before committing it.

requirements.name: AgentShield security scanner (secrets, tool and shell permissions, MCP configuration)
requirements.note: Never `npx --yes ecc-agentshield`: only the pinned, installed version runs. Projects without package.json run it in CI instead.
